surface: Cowork (composer mode toggle plus pack row, apps/agent-console retired; served natively at the chat origin, vendor/open-webui/src/lib/hive/)
minimum_proven_note: The coverage floor. RATCHET UP ONLY, and never by the run doing the checking: this number moves only in a deliberate commit a human or an agent has to justify in review. Set to 3 on 2026-08-29/30 alongside a full retirement of the C1-C24 ledger below (see 'retired'): C1-C24 measured apps/agent-console served at /agent-workspace, which now 404s everywhere (issue #944, D-045, confirmed live 2026-08-29). The replacement surface is the Chat/Cowork toggle inside the chat composer plus its pack row (#1500), native at the chat origin. 3 is what the unauthenticated group (C25-C27) proves with only SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_ANON_KEY/SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY set, which is the demo box's actual secret state confirmed by `gh secret list` on 2026-08-30 (HIVE_QA_AGENT_EMAIL and HIVE_QA_AGENT_PASSWORD are both absent). The authenticated group (C28-C33, six controls) needs HIVE_QA_AGENT_EMAIL provisioned as a repo secret pointed at an identity dedicated to this measurement (see agent-workspace-flows.spec.ts's own AGENT_EMAIL_FAILURE_REASON); the floor rises to 9 the day that secret exists and the group runs clean. HIVE_QA_AGENT_PASSWORD is not needed by this ledger at all: sign-in on this surface goes through Open WebUI's own OAuth-only entry to the Hive OIDC provider (ENABLE_LOGIN_FORM is false and OAUTH_AUTO_REDIRECT is true on this deployment, deploy/docker/docker-compose.yml), so nothing here ever types a password.
note: The control ledger. It is edited by hand. C33 checks that hand against the deployed composer narrowly (see not_present below for why this is not a whole-page sweep): it counts the Cowork mode and pack radiogroup segments and requires the counts to equal what a two-mode, two-pack design implies. A control that ships without an entry here fails the 'no test in this run' check in build-agent-workspace-coverage.mjs rather than quietly shrinking the denominator. Entries with an empty `dom` are behaviours rather than elements (a redirect, an API response body, an API status), so nothing in a DOM sweep can enumerate them. The coverage file is generated from a live run and is not committed; see the build script. Never renumber an id once a run has used it.

retired.why: Every one of these measured apps/agent-console served at https://chat-hive.scubed.co/agent-workspace: a standalone app with its own Supabase-email-password sign-in form, its own /tasks page, a Cancel button per row, an empty state and a retry banner. Confirmed live 2026-08-29: both /agent-workspace and /agent-workspace/auth/sign-in return 404 (deploy/docker/Caddyfile.owui's @removedSurfaces block; PR #951; D-045). The surface was not deleted, it moved: Cowork is now a mode of the chat composer (vendor/open-webui/src/lib/hive/ComposerModeToggle.svelte, ComposerCoworkRow.svelte, Chat.svelte's submitCoworkRun/applyCoworkRun/followCoworkRun), and a run renders as a transcript turn rather than a row on a separate page. Removed rather than kept as dead entries with an empty `dom`, because build-agent-workspace-coverage.mjs fails loudly on any declared control with no matching [C#] test in the run ("control(s) have no test in this run"), and nothing in this rewrite tests the old DOM. C9 (Back to chat link) has no successor: the composer surface has no separate page to link back from, it is the chat app itself. C1-C5/C8 (the email/password sign-in form and its validation) have no successor either: ENABLE_LOGIN_FORM is false on this deployment (deploy/docker/docker-compose.yml), so that form is never in the DOM to test, on either surface. Some function survives, at the SEPARATE /agents route (vendor/open-webui/src/lib/hive/AgentTasks.svelte, still live, 200, per issue #1501's 2026-08-29 finding), which is owned by issue #1501 and out of scope here: its own coverage, if it gets one, is a different ledger.

not_present.why: The composer surface renders a run as transcript text only (coworkMode.ts's renderRun): there is no Cancel button anywhere in Chat.svelte's cowork path. C32 still proves the server-side cancel contract (POST .../cancel), called directly against the API for containment, exactly as the retired C17 did, but there is no UI control to enumerate for it.
not_present.guard: C33 asserts the composer's Cowork radiogroups hold exactly two mode segments and, once switched, exactly two pack segments, so a Cancel button (or anything else) added to that scoped region fails the count rather than silently expanding unlisted.

not_present.what: A sign-in screen DOM sweep (the retired C24's role)
not_present.why: OAUTH_AUTO_REDIRECT is true on this deployment with exactly one provider configured (deploy/docker/docker-compose.yml): an unauthenticated visitor is bounced out of Open WebUI's own /auth page and into the Hive OIDC provider before a person (or a Playwright locator) could reliably read a stable DOM there. A whole-DOM sweep of a page the app itself does not linger on is a race, not a guard, so it is not attempted. C25 and C26 instead assert the two properties that hold regardless of exactly where the bounce lands: the visitor never reaches signed-in content, and the server's own config confirms the local form is off and the Hive provider is configured.

controls.description: Unauthenticated chat entry never reaches signed-in app content (Open WebUI's own client-side auth guard, routes/(app)/+layout.svelte, redirects or the OAuth auto-redirect carries the browser further)
The chat origin's own GET /api/config reports enable_login_form false and the oidc provider configured, matching ENABLE_LOGIN_FORM=false / OAUTH_PROVIDER_NAME=Hive in deploy/docker/docker-compose.yml
GET /api/v1/hive/agent/tasks (the chat-origin proxy, deploy/docker/owui-patches/hive_agent_proxy.py) requires auth: 401 unauthenticated
A minted session lands on the chat home (new-chat ready), not stuck outside the app
Chat/Cowork mode toggle: a two-segment radiogroup defaulting to Chat, and selecting Cowork reveals the pack row
Cowork pack row: Knowledge work/Coding radios default to Knowledge work and reflect selection
Submitting blank/whitespace-only instructions in Cowork mode is refused client side and fires no request to the agent task collection

Cowork submission round-trips through POST /api/v1/hive/agent/tasks, the transcript turn renders the run's queued/running text, and the created task is cancelled server side in a finally whatever happens. Does NOT prove the sandbox stopped: control-plane's Engine interface has only Launch and Service.Cancel is a bare database transition (issue #886), unchanged from the retired C17.

The composer's Cowork controls are exactly two mode segments, and once Cowork is selected, exactly two pack segments -- a narrow, scoped denominator guard (see not_present above for why it is not a whole-composer sweep)
